name: Arena Vortex Elite finger paddle
description: Built tough — durable plastic and reliable tubing that survive seasons of chlorine and daily life crammed in a wet gear bag. The shape encourages a good catch position.

name: FINIS Axis Buoy, a 2-in-1 pull buoy and ankle float
description: The Swiss Army knife of foam peanuts. It works as a normal pull buoy, but the notched shape also doubles as an ankle float or an alignment tool.

name: Speedo silicone swim cap
description: The reliable default. Durable, comfortable, gentle on hair, and easy to pull on without the hair-yanking drama of latex.

name: FINIS Swimmer's Snorkel
description: The one we hand to first-timers and never worry about again. It doesn't leak, it stays put on flip turns, and the purge valve clears without a fight, so you can focus on technique instead of the tube.
